name: unity-scene-plan
description: Plan the Unity GameObject hierarchy and components for a 3D feature before any C#: scenes, prefabs, MonoBehaviour ownership, input model, networked authority for multiplayer. A 3D plan SHALL declare its render pipeline and a multiplayer plan its topology. Do not use to frame the game idea (use problem-framing in its game-design mode), slice a planned build (use implementation-plan), analyze blast radius (use impact-analysis), verify a running build (use app-runtime-verify), or without an active task folder (run task-init first).
